<!-- Source page: Mjolnir -->

[Mjolnir](https://github.com/matrix-org/mjolnir) is a moderation tool for Matrix chat.

It is documented in the [NixOS manual](https://nixos.org/manual/nixos/stable/#module-services-mjolnir).
